question: When can local observations identify which feeder was emptied, and can a lawful bot-side memory change its next action?
inputs: Persistent feeder, current own energy, prior actual action, anonymous menu, self-issued bit, outward slot and observed energy consequences.
forbidden_inputs: Ration ledger, true map, holder or feeder identity, inbound port, future growth, state of another game, oracle action or episode seed in either controller.
mapping: Frozen conservative history certificate, fixed prepared knot writer and fixed one-bit actuator coupling. Offline exact finite-support classification and matched pre-action interventions.
primary_observable: Certified correct reciprocal physical action flips per eligible paired history, separately by law. Censored or ambiguous histories stay in their denominators. Secondary held-out complete lifetimes.
comparators_or_controls: Current-only, full public history, true sham, actual memory transposition, equal memory and disconnected writer/readout. Natural play separate from forced preparations.
resource_budget: First 16 mechanism founders, 16 tapes, 56 schedules, two namings. Separate 48 held-out founders, four tapes and four bots. Frozen optional construction extension of 32 founders and 32 tapes only for missing witnesses.
first_executable_signal: Rescore turns 15/21 and compare exact public histories with the frozen certificate.
stop_rule: Per-law causal write-to-choice witness or earliest missing operation in the frozen apparatus, with separate survival and decisive seed replays.
nonclaims: Finite source and supplied game, sensor, memory assembly, writer, schedule, readout and movement execution. No claim of evolved memory, learning or globally optimal survival.
